title: Three product screens
slide_intent: Compare key moments in one service so expressive language and functional hierarchy can be evaluated together.
strategic_value: A shared green, heavy headlines and textured illustrations can connect Wise’s entry, card and confirmation experiences.
demonstration: Three white phone-shaped panels show an account welcome, a card/balance view and an It All Adds Up message on a pale-gray field.
practical_value: Compare where illustration leads and where financial information takes priority.

content_islands.name: Welcome screen
content_islands.spec: Place the globe illustration above a stacked account headline.

content_islands.name: Card screen
content_islands.spec: Center the green card with balance and controls.

content_islands.name: Message screen
content_islands.spec: Pair celebratory illustration with the closing phrase and action.
